name: Signature
description: Represents a digital signature attached to a document. Signature objects are contained in the SignatureSet collection of the Document object.
remarks: You can add a Signature object to a SignatureSet collection by using the Add method, and you can return an existing member by using the Item method. To remove a Signature from a SignatureSet collection, use the Delete method of the Signature object.
example:
Function AddSignature(ByVal strIssuer As String, _
 strSigner As String) As Boolean

 On Error GoTo Error_Handler

 Dim sig As Signature

 'Display the dialog box that lets the
 'user select a digital signature.
 'If the user selects a signature, then
 'it is added to the Signatures
 'collection. If the user does not, then
 'an error is returned.
 Set sig = ActiveDocument.Signatures.Add

 'Test several properties before commiting the Signature object to disk.
 If sig.Issuer = strIssuer And _
 sig.Signer = strSigner And _
 sig.IsCertificateExpired = False And _
 sig.IsCertificateRevoked = False And _
 sig.IsValid = True Then

 MsgBox "Signed"
 AddSignature = True
 'Otherwise, remove the Signature object from the SignatureSet collection.
 Else
 sig.Delete
 MsgBox "Not signed"
 AddSignature = False
 End If

 'Commit all signatures in the SignatureSet collection to the disk.
 ActiveDocument.Signatures.Commit

 Exit Function
Error_Handler:
 AddSignature = False
 MsgBox "Action canceled."
End Function

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the Signature object (you can use this property with an Automation object to return that object's container application). Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the Signature object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Gets the Parent object for the Signature object. Read-only.

properties.name: IsSigned
properties.description: Gets a Boolean value indicating whether the document was signed successfully. Read-only.

properties.name: Details
properties.description: Gets information about a signature. Read-only.

properties.name: CanSetup
properties.description: Gets a Boolean value indicating whether the user can set properties of the Signature object. Read-only.

properties.name: Setup
properties.description: Gets a SignatureSetup object that provides access to various properties of a signature packet. Read-only.

properties.name: IsSignatureLine
properties.description: Gets a value indicating whether this is a signature line. Read-only.

properties.name: SignatureLineShape
properties.description: Gets the Shape object associated with a Signature object that is a signature line. Read-only.

properties.name: SortHint
properties.description: Gets a value representing the sort order of the signatures in a packet with multiple signatures. Read-only.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes the Signature object from the collection.
